text.description_html:
Omnia 726/300, Stainless Contoured Shower Door Pull Pair

Very stylish contoured stainless shower door pulls by Omnia. The flowing wavy design makes handles perfect for the watery shower environment. Made from long lasting solid stainless steel in your choice of Satin Stainless Steel or Polished Stainless Steel

Specifications for the Omnia SD-726/300 Stainless Steel Shower Door Pulls:

  • Overall Length: 14-15/16"
  • Mounting Centers: 11-3/4" Center to Center Hole Spacing
  • Projection: 2-3/4"
  • Material: 304 Solid Stainless Steel

Packaged with 2 door pull handles and includes the hardware for back to back mounting on 1/4" to 5/8" thick glass doors.

*Sold as a Pair (2 Pulls) **Drill holes in glass 3/8" to 5/8" diameter.
